articles.title: Standard Chartered's Zodia Custody suffers data breach, exposing client information
articles.snippet: The breach exposed client and employee contact information at Standard Chartered's crypto custodian, which said no unauthorized transactions took place.

articles.title: Zcash developers want to phase out older privacy system as a precaution against future attacks
articles.snippet: Zakura is pushing to stop new payments into Sapling sooner, citing the possibility that AI-assisted discoveries could weaken the math protecting it.

articles.title: Over 1,000 Bitcoin miners were tricked into working for a thief by a fake internet route
articles.snippet: An attacker steered up to 1.9 EH/s of mining power to an impostor pool earlier in November using a weakness most of the industry's largest pools still carry.

articles.title: Vitalik Buterin calls for verifiable chips as hardware wallet threats evolve
articles.snippet: Buterin warned that future attacks could use lookalike chips with hidden malicious functions, making hardware tampering harder to detect.

articles.title: Braiins warns of Bitcoin mining attacks affecting over 1,000 sites
articles.snippet: Bitcoin mining pool operator Braiins warned that attackers are exploiting unsecured connections to hijack miners’ computing power and potentially steal rewards.
